analysis.visual_description: On the bookwheel. A thin new book, open at the front, under a stall's awning. Plain daylight. His two hands hold it. The title page names the book and the year. No author is named.
On the bookwheel. One sentence of the epistle, under the heading The Author to his loving Cosen.
On the bookwheel. Daniel's book stays shut under his arm. The new book has the hands. He has already seen that his own copy's line stood.
